topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.summary: 工具使用须遵守 UL 数据保护、IT 安全及可接受使用政策；本来源集合未核实所有可用数据类别。
topics.scope: 属于合规框架，工具被点名不等于敏感数据通用批准。

claims.text: Tool use must comply with UL’s Data Protection, IT Security and Acceptable Usage policies. This source set does not establish every permitted data category.

evidence.quote: The use of any tool within the University must be compliant with the UL Data Protection Policy, IT Security Policy, and the Acceptable Usage Policy.

topics.title: 机构工具
topics.summary: 若使用生成式 AI，UL 当前偏好师生通过大学账户使用 Microsoft Copilot；个人开通与考核许可须分别确认。
topics.scope: 偏好平台指引；未核实个人工具资格与费用。

claims.text: UL currently prefers Microsoft Copilot through staff or student accounts if GenAI is used. Individual activation and assessment permission remain separate.

evidence.quote: From a security and data integrity standpoint, if Gen AI is to be used by staff or students, the preferred platform is currently Microsoft Copilot, accessed through UL staff or student accounts.

topics.title: 研究与发表
topics.summary: 用于重要信息、决策或研究的生成式 AI 输出须独立核实；发表及学位论文专属披露规则仍有缺口。
topics.scope: 适用于依赖输出的情形，包括科研；不代表所有科研用途均获批准。

claims.text: GenAI outputs used for essential information, decisions or research must be independently verified. Publication and thesis-specific disclosure rules remain a gap.

evidence.quote: As a result, all outputs from Gen AI tools which we rely on for essential information or which will inform decisions or influence research must be independently verified.
evidence.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence

topics.evidenceScope: Reliance on outputs, including research; not blanket approval of any research use.

additionalTopics.scope: 政策自 2025 年 9 月实施，2026 年 6 月记有小幅修订；不能因出现指控就推断自动处罚。
